name: The Deathstalkers
summary: In the Undercity, the Deathstalkers move against suspected treason in the Forsaken's own ranks. Under Lord Varimathras's orders, you pose as an expected messenger and question a merchant who may be aiding an outside faction.

sections.title: A Web of Deceit
sections.body: Deathstalker Mennet Carkad sets an infiltration in motion at Lord Varimathras's urging. The Deathstalkers watch the Forsaken's own citizens as closely as they guard against outside threats. With Astor Hadren's letter of introduction, forged or acquired, you approach the local merchant Andron Gant and try to pass as the courier he expects.

sections.title: The Shop Near the Apothecarium
sections.body: Andron Gant keeps a shop near the Apothecarium. Mennet believes the shopkeeper lacks the wit to spot an impostor. When you show the letter, Gant accepts your cover as a courier, lowers his guard, and begins describing dealings with an unidentified third party.

faq.answer: Andron Gant is a shopkeeper in the Undercity, near the Apothecarium. The Deathstalkers and Lord Varimathras suspect he is funneling intelligence and aid to an unknown outside faction.

faq.q: Why is Lord Varimathras interested in this merchant?
faq.answer: Lord Varimathras suspects Gant is working with an organization outside the Forsaken. He wants proof of Gant's contacts and intentions to protect the city and root out subversion.

faq.q: How does the player deceive Andron Gant?
faq.answer: Mennet Carkad gives you Astor's Letter of Introduction. Gant expects a courier, and the Deathstalkers consider him easy to fool, so the letter wins his confidence.

The Deathstalkers are the Forsaken's elite rogue order and secret intelligence agency. They work from the shadows under Queen Sylvanas and Lord Varimathras to uncover sedition, sabotage enemies, and remove threats within their ranks.

faq.q: Where can Andron Gant be found?
faq.answer: Andron Gant works in his shop near the entrance to the Apothecarium quarter in the Undercity. He does business under the watch of the Royal Apothecary Society and the Deathstalkers.

faq.q: What happens after Gant accepts the letter?
faq.answer: Gant accepts the letter without suspicion and takes you for a messenger with nothing to hide. He hints at cooperation with mutual acquaintances, giving you a chance to seek further proof of his betrayal.

angles.text: As a rogue, you use a dead man's identity to draw out a careless conspirator, a method the Deathstalkers know well.
As Forsaken, you know vigilance means survival. A citizen found aiding outside factions risks being purged by the dark lady's secret police.
As Horde, you know political intrigue reaches beneath the Undercity. Even within Horde borders, trust is scarce.
